## Claake Code Remote

- Control the agent on your Mac from your iPhone. Open **Remote** in Claake Code, turn it on, then scan the QR code and add the web app to your home screen (Safari › Share › Add to Home Screen).
- Pair with a 6-digit code. Messages between the phone and the Mac are end-to-end encrypted. The relay only forwards frames it cannot read.
- On the phone: list and open conversations, start a classic or RLM chat, pick the project, model and thinking level, follow the agent's answers and tools live, answer its questions, and stop a turn.
- Notifications when the agent finishes, even when the app is closed (iOS 16.4+, web app added to the home screen).
- Revoke a paired phone at any time from the Remote panel on the Mac.

## Dictée page (iPhone)

- A new **Dictée** page (mic icon on the home screen) transcribes your voice in French, live.
- Edit the text, then tap **Utiliser dans un nouveau chat**. It opens a new conversation with the text in the composer, ready to send. Nothing is sent automatically.
- The microphone only turns on after you agree: Safari's speech recognition may send audio to Apple's servers. The iPhone keyboard dictation remains available.

## Changes

- The Remote relay moves to a new server (Cloudflare). The old relay is gone, so phones paired with an older version must pair again.
